purpose: Challenge the five-link semantic kernel rooted at the associative root before choosing parser, deictic, projection, or production interpreter semantics.

centralReading.researchMeaning: the associative root is the meaning of meaning: meaning is related to meaning by the same primitive link ontology

relationalResolutionHypothesis.claimToChallengeLater: constructor/destructor behavior may be resolution direction of one declarative relation rather than two meanings of a glyph

requiredAssertions: the kernel is finite and closed
the kernel contains exactly five semantic refs in this isolated challenge
all five refs have distinct ordered pairs
R is the unique fully self-closed ref in the kernel
O and C are distinguishable only by orientation relative to R
L and U are reversed ordered relations over O/C
kernel role recognition survives arbitrary ref renumbering
kernel role recognition does not inspect glyph labels
Link values contain only start/end refs and no meaning metadata
an unrelated finite link is not silently classified as one of the five meanings
notDecided: meaning derivation for an arbitrary non-kernel link
whether ⟼ is best named constructor or a bidirectional relation
